title: Function calls not recognised in `create table ... as select` when `as` is lowercase
spec:
This is the sqlparse library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests`.

```python
import sqlparse
from sqlparse import sql
p = sqlparse.parse('create table tbl1 as select coalesce(t1.col1, 0) as col1 from t1')[0]
```

EXPECTED: `coalesce(t1.col1, 0)` is grouped into a `sql.Function` (as it is when the statement is written `CREATE TABLE tbl1 AS select ...`).
ACTUAL: no `sql.Function` is produced anywhere in the tree.

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: The lowercase-`as` statement yields a Function for coalesce
